Citlivá mechanika + zátěž proti vaší vla: Sensitive mechanics + load against your own capacity (volume, intensity, descent, ascent). Unlocks the Training tab with a daily recommendation.
Citlivý engine počítá odchylku každého b: The Sensitive engine measures each run's deviation against your own typical error and weights fresh runs more, so it catches a change earlier than the average-based Standard engine — tuned so that without a real change it shows a signal in only about 5 % of cases. All engines convert mechanics to your usual pace, so slower jogs don't look like drift. The Capacity engine also judges load against what you've shown you can handle without problems — per run and per week, in volume, intensity (heart-rate zones), descent and ascent — and lowers it according to how well you slept. Experimental — not yet validated on real injuries.
Denní shrnutí vašeho stavu, komentář k d: A daily summary of your state, a comment on today's training (Capacity engine) and every Monday a summary of the past week. A language model writes them only from the numbers the app calculates. They don't change the recommendation, and every text is checked automatically — if it fails the check, you get a text put together directly by the app instead. The same consent switches on the Physio AI Assistant, which answers questions about your data, training and the app from your numbers and from research studies.
